parts.text: You are provided with two solids: solid R and solid S. Do the following tests on solid R and solid S, recording all of your observations at each stage. Tests on solid R

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Transfer about half of solid R to a boiling tube. Gently heat the solid for about 30 seconds. Record your observations. .................................................................................................................................................... .............................................................................................................................................. [2] Transfer the remaining solid R to a boiling tube. Add about 5 cm depth of distilled water to the boiling tube and place a stopper in the boiling tube. Shake the boiling tube to dissolve solid R and form solution R. Divide solution R into three approximately equal portions in two boiling tubes and one test-tube.

ms.label: 2(a)
ms.text:
M1 forms a solution / melts / becomes liquid
M2 steam / condensation (at top of tube)

ms.label: 2(b)
ms.text:
M1 white precipitate
M2 dissolves in excess

ms.label: 2(c)
ms.text:
M1 white precipitate
M2 remains / does not dissolve

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) Carry out a ﬂame test on solid S. Record your observations. .............................................................................................................................................. [1] Transfer the remaining solid S to a boiling tube. Add about 4 cm depth of distilled water to the boiling tube and place a stopper in the boiling tube. Shake the boiling tube to dissolve solid S and form solution S. Divide solution S into two approximately equal portions in two test-tubes.

ms.label: 2(g)
ms.text: no change / no reaction / remains colourless

parts.label: h
parts.text: (h) To the second portion of solution S, add a few drops of acidiﬁed aqueous potassium manganate( VII ). Record your observations. .............................................................................................................................................. [1]
